title: Harness
subtitle: One card per tool module, generated from the conformance contract.

entries.label: Local DB
entries.subtitle: SQLite insert, query, count, delete

entries.label: Scanner
entries.subtitle: Decode a 1D barcode or 2D QR symbol from a still image, an injected code or the live camera

entries.label: Haptics
entries.subtitle: Drive the vibration actuator with semantic impacts, one-shot timings or a W3C waveform

entries.label: Beeper
entries.subtitle: Synthesize a sine, square or triangle tone, or a short melodic sequence, through the audio actuator

entries.label: Camera
entries.subtitle: Capture a still frame or toggle the torch through the CameraX host

entries.label: Files
entries.subtitle: Read and write files inside the workspace sandbox: write, read, append, copy, move, list, info, delete, mkdir, exists, uri

entries.label: Image editing
entries.subtitle: Crop, resize, adjust colour, threshold, smooth or remove the background of an image and return the processed URI

entries.label: Embedding
entries.subtitle: Embed text (512-d hashed fallback when the MediaPipe text JNI is absent) or an image descriptor, and score two texts for similarity

entries.label: Clipboard
entries.subtitle: Copy text to the system clipboard, paste it back, or clear it

entries.label: Biometrics
entries.subtitle: Ask the OS for device-credential confirmation

entries.label: Libsignal
entries.subtitle: Establish a Double-Ratchet session, encrypt, decrypt and verify a 60-digit safety number

entries.label: Image classifier
entries.subtitle: Run the bundled MobileNetV4 ImageNet-1k classifier over a real image

entries.label: Background removal
entries.subtitle: Salient-object segmentation

entries.label: Push alerts
entries.subtitle: Post a local notification into a channel with a priority

entries.label: Offline cache
entries.subtitle: Persist a page snapshot, report cache statistics, or clear the cache

entries.label: Realtime channel
entries.subtitle: Open a websocket channel, subscribe, send a frame and disconnect

entries.label: Network
entries.subtitle: HTTP GET, POST, download and upload plus the in-process LAN hub: serve, stop, status, share, list, unshare

entries.label: Printer
entries.subtitle: Scan for ESC/POS printers, pair, connect and print a receipt

entries.label: Codec
entries.subtitle: Base64 and Base45 round trips plus the JSON transfer codec: validate, extract, stringify, chunk and assemble with a checksum

entries.label: Code generator
entries.subtitle: Render a QR, EAN-13 or Code 128 symbol to a PNG and publish a decodable payload

entries.label: Screen
entries.subtitle: Keep the screen awake, capture a screenshot or start and stop a recording through the host sinks

entries.label: Data views
entries.subtitle: Chart and list blocks
